notes:
- Currently arriving is one row: airing and upcoming share a single strip by default, with Settings > Library > Arriving rows offering the two labelled groups, and compact rows following the same choice.
- Your own font, without the restart: each import gets a fresh file name and an atomic move, so the new face is visible immediately; the theme validates and caches it, and a failed import leaves the current font working.
- Text size reaches further: the reading scale is 80-140% in 5% stops, and markdown headings finally follow it instead of hardcoding 16/18/20sp.
- The waiting page has the page's shape: the dashboard skeleton mirrors stats, arriving, search, filters, the section header and the cards, with one shimmer sweeping the whole stack.
- State changes, not swaps: the refresh button crossfades between icon and spinner, and the login carousel dots stretch from their centre in the draw phase.
- Smaller fixes: "Airing · 12 eps" reads correctly, compact arriving separators hold across group labels, and arriving cards share their press interaction source with the card so scrolling no longer leaves one squashed.
